senses.gloss: (cmp. אַרְבֵּל II, a. סְרַב II) to interlace. Part. pass. מְסוּרְבָּל; pl. מְסוּרְבָּלִין (with, or sub. בשר, בבשר) interwoven with flesh, fat, thick.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 137b:3">Sabb. 137ᵇ</cite> <he>קטן המס׳ בבשר</he> a child whose membrum is overgrown with flesh (so that the sign of the covenant is invisible); <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:9">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:9">XVI</cite>), 9.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:7">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>ומס׳</he> (<he>בשר</he>) <he>כדוב</he> fleshy like a bear; <cite ref="Megillah 11a:4">Meg. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:9">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 316">Yalk. Is. 316</cite>.
